scope.e1: selected supervised E1 learning rate per task

definitions.absa_presence: positive iff label > 0; ViSFD OTHERS is raw code 4 and remains detection-positive
definitions.viSFD_prediction_mapping: serialized/model OTHERS 1 is mapped to raw code 4 for error comparison; OTHERS is excluded from pair/polarity counts
definitions.polarity_error: both present but exact label differs; OTHERS is not treated as a polarity label
definitions.train_rarity: aspect presence support computed on TRAIN only; rare <= train presence Q1, frequent >= train presence Q4, middle otherwise
definitions.length: validation text length uses whitespace tokens: short 0-10, medium 11-20, long 21+
definitions.truncation: measured separately with the local GoiBERT tokenizer, no model inference
